description:
Create accessible PDF documents directly from Microsoft PowerPoint.

axesSlide is a Microsoft PowerPoint add-in that converts presentations into accessible PDFs that meet PDF/UA and WCAG requirements.
Improvements
- The conversion of URIs into the format required for PDF is more stable.
Bug Fixes
- In the roles panel, selection and the drag & drop indicator did not work correctly at high screen resolutions.
- Selecting certain elements caused the current slide view to reset.
Known Issues
- Sensitivity Labels in Office 365 that result in document encryption are not supported.
